description: This file defines the interface for PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) processing in a 3GPP NR (5G) context. It includes class definitions for processing different PUCCH formats, configuration structures for each format, and a validator interface for configuration validation.

classes.name: ocudu::pucch_processor
classes.description: Interface class for processing various PUCCH formats, providing virtual methods for each format's processing logic.

classes.name: ocudu::pucch_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface class for validating PUCCH configuration parameters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a specific PUCCH format message or batch, returning the processing result.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates a given PUCCH configuration structure, returning success or error message.
